before: A room kept every item for its whole life: a rejected insertion, an accepted deletion and a taken back word stayed in the list, hidden, and only a fold dropped them as a side effect. A place in a unit that a load never made, in a loaded paragraph, was refused as not-covered. A room applied an author's undo of own edits made before its file.
after: A close can call compactOrdered before it saves: it removes each item that no change can show again and that nothing reads, ends the undo of own edits, treats a direct edit as final as a decision (what it hid goes, and a control it emptied keeps its prompt), and keeps every suggestion. The cards, the Word file and each decision stay the same. A place in a removed unit is refused as unknown-address. A room refuses an author's undo of own edits (a retract's undo) that names a change made before its file as other-file, as it refuses a revert of such a direct edit, so no change after a close needs what the cleanup removed.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest and the Word file do not change. Only the room's item list after a close is smaller, and every client opens the room's file after a close, so all copies hold the same list. Nothing calls the cleanup until the close path does. other-file is a refusal code every client already reads, and a client's undo history forgets every change at a close's reload, so no client of this version sends such an undo.
